title: MoveRDM Dataset Explorer
subtitle: MoveRDM Initiative / MPIAB & University of Konstanz
description: High-performance research data repository frontend built for the MoveRDM initiative, featuring live integration with the Movebank API via Cloudflare Workers, dynamic query building and client-side stream parsing.
longDescription: Engineered specifically to support modern research data management (RDM) workflows for ecological and behavioral telemetry. The architecture bridges local mock storage with high-throughput scientific data pipelines, utilizing a secure Cloudflare Workers proxy to handle authentication, CORS mitigation, and raw TSV/CSV stream parsing on the fly into reactive Angular models.

architecture.title: Middleware & Data Ingestion Pipeline
architecture.description: Decoupled architecture ensuring secure credential handling and high-speed telemetry parsing for scientific workflows.
steps: Secure API Gateway & Basic Auth injection via Cloudflare Workers proxy
Dynamic query generation targeting Movebank entities (study, tag_type, taxon, deployment)
Asynchronous client-side CSV/TSV raw stream parsing into type-safe Angular signals
Persistent data structures compatible with institutional repositories (DSpace / PostgreSQL)

scientificImpact: Streamlines access to massive multi-dimensional animal tracking datasets for researchers
Reduces latency through reactive client-side caching and optimized data grids
Ensures compliance with open science data sharing and metadata standards (Darwin Core / Movebank XML)
keyFeatures: Multi-repository dataset search with real-time faceted filtering across ecological and telemetry parameters
Seamless DSpace institutional repository integration for direct metadata publishing and DOI minting
Advanced spatial bounding box and temporal range query tools for precise geographic data retrieval
Interactive dataset preview supporting tabular metadata, spatial layers, and file structure inspection
Automated schema validation against Darwin Core and Movebank standards before synchronization
Export capabilities supporting multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and Darwin Core Archives
